meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、预览和发布动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用简单的命令制作和分享动画视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and publish animated videos with a command-line tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and share animated videos using simple commands.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会改用 HyperFrames CLI 的流程来制作视频:先查目录、再写合成、用 lint/check 校验,通过预览并确认后才渲染,并核对输出文件。遇到构建或渲染失败时也用该 CLI 诊断。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作或编辑视频、查找已有动效,或诊断构建或渲染失败时。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目初始化成 HyperFrames 视频,并生成一个示例。
say.note: 会先初始化项目,再按流程走。

say.text: 用 catalog 查一下怎么逐行揭示标题,然后添加那个动效。
say.note: 会先查本地目录,找到就安装该动效。

say.text: 先跑 preview --background,等我看过再渲染。
say.note: 会在浏览器打开最终预览,等你确认后才渲染。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude drives video work through the HyperFrames CLI: search the catalog, author the composition, lint and check, preview, render only after approval, and verify the output. It also uses the CLI to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create or edit a video, find an existing motion effect, or diagnose build or render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize this project as a HyperFrames video with a sample.
say_en.note: It scaffolds the project and starts the loop.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for revealing a headline line by line, then add the move.
say_en.note: It searches locally and installs the matching primitive.

say_en.text: Open the final preview in background and wait for my approval before rendering.
say_en.note: It keeps the preview alive and pauses at render.
